claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cloths for leaving skin very soft, smooth, and clean, with many calling them the best scrubber they've used.
Several reviewers warn that the authentic Japanese version is rougher and better, while softer or China-made versions are knock-offs of inferior quality.
Some long-time users report the current product is noticeably softer and thinner than before, so it no longer exfoliates or scrubs as well.
Reviewers describe the cloths as rough/scratchy at first but effective, and note they rinse clean easily.
Multiple reviewers mention discovering the product through MakeupAlley or buying it repeatedly and gifting it to family and friends.

qa.answer: Yes, reviews report it exfoliates well: it exfoliates without force [1], works well for exfoliating skin and reducing ingrown hairs/blemishes [2], and removes old dulling skin cells leaving baby-soft skin [5][6].
